serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: *panting*
What happened to her?
Policewoman: I came as fast as I could. Did you already apprehend the suspect?
Policeman: Yeah, got him right there.
Policewoman: Wait, why isn’t he in handcuffs?
You: Handcuffs?! 
#Policeman.Face.angry
Policeman: Shut up!
#Policeman.Face.normal
Policeman: No need, he wasn’t resisting.
#Policewoman.Face.angry
Policewoman: He wasn’t resisting?! What do you mean he wasn’t resisting?! You said ‘shots fired’ over the radio!
Policeman: Yeah… I panicked a little, sorry about that. 
Policewoman: That’s not ‘a little’! What would happen if I shot the guy?!
#Policeman.Face.angry
Policeman: Sorry, ok?! It was this scary looking pale guy again and I knew you would come quicker if I exaggerated a little!
Policewoman: He’s just your local bum dude, you can’t just shout ‘shots fired’ through the radio over every little thing like that!
#Policeman.Face.normal
#Policewoman.Face.normal
Policeman: Yeah, yeah. I’m sorry, it won’t happen again…
Policewoman: …
You: I’m not a bum.
Policewoman: Please, sir, shut up for a second, ok?!
You: …
Policeman: Oh, right. What about our burritos?
Policewoman: Obviously, left at the shop. I’m not gonna run to an active shooting with freaking burritos in hands!
#Policeman.Face.angry
#Policewoman.Face.angry
Policeman: W-what?! You just left them?! Are you crazy?!
Policewoman: You have NO RIGHT to call me crazy! It is you who royally fucked up! 
Policeman: We are talking about burritos here for Christ’s sake! 
This is embarrassing… 
You: Um, can I go already?
Policeman and Policewoman: Yes please!
…
